title: KL-MOPD: Discrepancy-Aware Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coordinating multiple recommendation objectives (e.g., click and conversion) is critical for real-world generative recommendation (GR). However, since a positive item in GR can be retrieved only when its tokens are successively selected at every decoding step, traditional item-wise methods lack fine-grained token-wise supervision to guide intermediate steps. Motivated by its success in foundation models, we consider introducing multi-objective on-policy distillation (MOPD) into GR to distill two single-objective teachers into a student at each token. Yet, we find that in vanilla MOPD, (i) teachers exhibit unequal distillation difficulty at each token (i.e., token-level imbalance), and (ii) the harder-to-distill teacher varies across tokens (i.e., cross-token inconsistency), leaving each objective poorly learned at certain steps and hindering positive item retrieval for both objectives, leading to suboptimal performance. translated_title: KL-MOPD：面向生成式推荐的差异感知多目标在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 协调多个推荐目标（例如点击与转化）对真实场景下的生成式推荐（GR）至关重要。然而，由于在GR中，一个正样本物品只有在每个解码步骤中其token被依次成功选中时才能被检索到，传统的物品级方法缺乏细粒度的token级监督来引导中间步骤。受其在基础模型中成功的启发，我们考虑将多目标在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）引入GR，在每个token处将两个单目标教师模型蒸馏到一个学生模型中。然而，我们发现，在原始的MOPD中：（i）教师模型在每个token处表现出不相等的蒸馏难度（即token级不平衡），（ii）更难蒸馏的教师模型会随token而变化（即跨token不一致性），这使得每个目标在某些步骤中学习不佳，并阻碍了两个目标的正样本物品检索，导致次优性能。为了解决这一问题……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出KL-MOPD方法，通过差异感知的多目标在线策略蒸馏来缓解token级蒸馏难度不平衡与跨token教师不一致的问题，从而在生成式推荐中更好地协调点击、转化等多个推荐目标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KL-MOPD, a discrepancy-aware multi-objective on-policy distillation method that mitigates token-level imbalance and cross-token inconsistency to better coordinate multiple recommendation objectives in generative recommendation.
